messages:
tj: Quick one — onboarding the 'beta-mistral-7b' weights. HF repo link: https://huggingface.co/org/mistral/beta-mistral-7b. Do we have an S3 mirror already? I found a partial mirror at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mistral/beta-mistral-7b/ but there's no manifest.sha256. Need checksums, presigned urls, and tokenizer notes. Who owns this model?

maria: I created the initial mirror yesterday but didn't finish checksumming. Bucket is redwood-artifacts-prod. I'll upload manifest + .sha256 tonight. Do we prefer sha256 or md5 for artifacts? I vote sha256.

alex: sha256 please. Also remember to include config.yaml with pad_token_id/eos_token_id — our runtime rejects models that don't explicitly set pad_token_id.

sam: +1 on explicit config. Also a tokenizer quirk: this tokenizer uses </s> as id 0 which collides with our system token mapping. We'll need a small mapping in the tokenizer adapter. @maria can you attach tokenizer.json when you upload?

maria: attaching snippet here so folks can see:
```json
{"tokenizer_type":"sentencepiece","special_tokens":{"eos":0,"unk":1}}
```
We can convert to a BPE-backed tokenizer with transformers if needed but prefer not to re-tokenize weights.

jen: who has IAM to presign objects? I'll need presigned urls for local inference tests. @artifact-bot can you create presign for s3://redwood-artifacts-prod/models/mistral/beta-mistral-7b/weights-00000-of-00008.bin ttl=24h

artifact-bot: presign created: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/.../weights-00000-of-00008.bin?X-Amz-... :thumbsup:

tj: thanks. maria — can you add manifest.json listing all shard keys and per-shard sha256 sums, and put config.yaml and tokenizer.json under the same prefix? After that open a PR to the model-registry with the s3 path + checksums.

maria: will do. PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/342

alex: quick validation commands I ran locally (for reference):
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts-prod --key models/mistral/beta-mistral-7b/weights-00000-of-00008.bin
sha256sum weights-00000-of-00008.bin
```
head-object returned Content-Length matching expected size.

sam: runtime note: set config.yaml->generation->pad_token_id explicitly. Also add 'requires_kv_cache: true' if the model uses past key/value caching, otherwise serving will mis-handle fast incremental decoding.

tj: pinging @security for confirmation on mirroring policy for HF origins before we fully mirror. Also we'll keep bucket ACL private and use our artifact replication/backup rules.

maria: ACK — will set object ACL to private and add origin: "hf://org/mistral/beta-mistral-7b" in registry metadata.

jen: code-review ping for the PR @alex @tj

alex: reviewing now :eyes:

artifact-bot: CI run: model-registry/pull/342 -> Tests/validate-manifest PASSED :white_check_mark:

tj: perfect. once merged we'll kick off the ingest job to onboard to dedicated canary cluster. ETA tomorrow morning. :coffee:

maria: updated PR with tokenizer mapping note and full per-shard checksum file. left followups in PR comments about adapter behaviour.

sam: I can add the adapter change to runtime — small wrapper mapping eos/id 0 -> correct internal token id. ETA few hours.

tj: assign to sam and mark for a canary rollout on the dedicated cluster. We'll add a routing fallback to a previous model variant if any decoding errors crop up.

jen: thanks everyone, keeping this thread for async updates and any followups. Feel free to drop short notes here :thumbsup:
